title: X402 Domain Scanner
description: Scan a root domain for X402 payment endpoints. Enter a domain and optionally list specific paths to check (one per line). Leave paths empty to use the built-in dictionary.

paths.title: Paths to Check (Optional)
paths.description: List specific paths to check, one per line. Leave empty to use the built-in dictionary.

maxPaths.title: Max Paths
maxPaths.description: Maximum number of paths to try when using the built-in dictionary.

useResidentialProxy.title: Use Residential Proxy (Bypass Blocks)
useResidentialProxy.description: Route requests through residential IPs to avoid datacenter blocks. Additional cost applies.

includeSubdomains.title: Include Subdomains
includeSubdomains.description: Also scan common subdomains like api.domain.
